author: Yffe
content: Transpile AST -> Verus-annotated Rust source, then invoke Verus. Mapping: req->requires, ens->ensures (must mention result for non-unit), inv->invariant, dec->decreases, fx pure -> no side effects, spec fn -> Verus spec fn. Each SpecTherm combinator lowers to its registry Verus definition. L1 rung: compile the same SpecTherm contract to runtime checks (executable spec fns) active in ALL build profiles, not just debug (design 6). Overflow is a proof obligation (design 4.4). Defer: runtime effect sandbox (compile-time fx subsumption only).
